Package frc.robot.commands.pathfind

Class Pathfind.Supplied

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SequentialCommandGroup
frc.robot.commands.pathfind.Pathfind
frc.robot.commands.pathfind.Pathfind.Supplied
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable
Enclosing class:
Pathfind
public static class Pathfind.Supplied extends Pathfind
Concrete Pathfind implementation that accepts a target pose via Supplier.

Useful for dynamic targets that may change during the command, or for creating Pathfind instances with a fixed target pose.

      protected edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose2d target()
      Description copied from class: Pathfind
      Gets the target pose for this navigation.

      Subclasses must implement this to provide the target, which may be constant or dynamic (e.g., based on vision measurements).

      Specified by:
      target in class Pathfind
      Returns:
      Target pose, or null if no valid target
